notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[p]• Permanently fixed the timer getting stuck on -1.
• Added new transition.
• Removed "RESET CRUMBS" button from the Settings screen.
• Removed particle system.
• Added support for translations.
• Added machine translations for Simplified Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Japanese, French, Polish and Traditional Chinese. If anyone wants to volunteer their time to help with more accurate translations, contact me on Discord. Help would be greatly appreciated.
• Fixed a tiny memory leak.
• Changed fonts for multiple language support.
• Ubuntu port released.

Join the Discord server to report bugs and make some suggestions.

Keep on baking
The Royal Bakery[/p]

• Changed the drop chance for Epic to 1 in 1 500 000.
• Changed the drop chance for Legendary to 1 in 15 000 000.
• Removed ALL previous Common Breads from the drop pool.
• Removed ALL previous Uncommon Breads from the drop pool.
• Removed ALL previous Rare Breads from the drop pool.
• Removed the Easter Breads from the drop pool and item store.
• Added 8 new Breads to the Common pool.
• Added 5 new Breads to the Uncommon pool.
• Added 3 new Breads to the Rare pool.
• Replaced all in-game backgrounds with new ones.

Join the Discord server to report bugs and make some suggestions.

Keep on baking
The Royal Bakery

notes.title: Easter Update
notes.content:
Happy belated Easter Everyone

• Added 3 new Easter Breads to the drop pool (Available till [b]25 April 2025[/b])
• Added 2 new Easter Breads to the Item Store. (Available till [b]25 April 2025[/b])
• Added the previous Christmas Breads to the game. They can now be equipped
• Updated some button icons
• Removed "005 - Whole Toasted" from the drop pool
• Removed "009 - FC-002-01" from the drop pool
• Removed "010 - FC-002-02" from the drop pool

[i]Note: I apologize for no updates the past few months. Life has been...hectic. Had some health issues and some personal stuff to work through. Also moved to a new house. But all is good now and looking forward to releasing new breads more regularly.[/i]

Join the Discord server to report bugs and make some suggestions.

Keep on baking and Happy Easter
The Royal Bakery

notes.title: Very Small Update
notes.content:
• Changed the drop rate to every 60-65 minutes with a maximum of 12 drops in 24 hours.
[i]This was done so the game doesn't need to run 24/7 with potential drops missed because they drop at the same time as some of the other item collection/clicker games. This might change in the future, but for now, it will stay at 60-65 minutes.[/i]

• [b]REMEMBER:[/b] The Halloween breads will only be available till [b]15 November 2024[/b], including the ones in the item store.

• Starting [b]16 November 2024[/b], some of the Common Bread will be removed from the drop pool.

Join the Discord server to report bugs and make some suggestions.

Keep on baking
The Royal Bakery
